title: perf(objectql): drop a required master's parent chain for a View All reader over unrestricted hops
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbSUQWB2j9eHYsRcrCiq1X1C)_

**Do not land before #33820 (ADR-0139 status-line amendment) merges.**

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:对"受控于父对象"且主从字段必填的明细对象,只有同时持有明细"查看全部"、且每一级主对象读取范围都不受限的读者(典型是单租户管理员),读取时不再带父链子查询;其他读者完全不变;所有写操作(条件更新/删除、按 id 写、钩子里的读取)仍带父链,行为与 main 完全一致。
- 为什么改:这类读者的父链子查询挡不住任何有主记录的行,只拖慢管理员的列表、计数和汇总(卡上 1M 行实测快 29% 到 42%,本 PR 未重测)。
- 风险与回滚:该类读者的合计、计数、汇总可能包含孤儿行(主记录缺失或为空的明细),这是维护者裁决接受的;限制读者、仅有明细查看全部的读者、普通成员仍看不到孤儿行;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`engine-readable-ids-permission-formula.ts` 第 5 步、`readerViewsAllOf` 与 `READABLE_IDS_WRITE_IN_FLIGHT`;`engine-middleware-and-context.ts` 新增的写作用域;`security-plugin-cbp-read-filter.test.ts` 的反向钉子与写路径钉子。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/security-plugin-cbp-read-filter.test.ts`,预期 12 个测试全绿。
- 需要你做的:等 #33820(ADR-0139 状态行修订)合并后再合并本 PR。

Fixes #33696

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## Ruling

Ruling record 6893666857 (replaces 6893097935), quoted verbatim as it binds this card:

> - The parent chain is dropped only for a reader who holds view-all on the detail AND whose every master hop answers unrestricted (the engine's per-hop scope, not `hasSuperuserReadBypass`), with a required master FK. That reader sees null and dangling-FK rows inside its own tenant wall, consistent with #30905 ruling A. Every other reader, members included, keeps the chain unchanged.
> - This deliberately lifts #24932 ruling B item 4 and ADR-0139 D6's ⛔ for that reader class only. **The PR must not land before the ADR-0139 status-line amendment** (citing this record; ADR-0055's 10-22 note in step) merges. That amendment is a docs/adr/** card for the skills lane, which the seat files.
> - Pins: the three controlled-by-parent-leaf-switch tests are rewritten for the view-all + unrestricted reader. Reverse pins stay: a reader with a restricted master hop, and a reader with view-all on the detail only, still never see null or dangling rows.
> - Release note: totals, counts and aggregates for that reader may include orphan rows. A follow-up card to close the orphan sources (option B of the original request) is owed as the PR's one loose-ends card.
> - Multi-tenant deployments: a tenant admin's master scope is the tenant wall, so it is not unrestricted. No speed-up there, by design; widening that is a separate decision.

## Review 6895328067: route (a), write doors unchanged

The review found that the drop reached the write doors. The security plugin's predicate-write narrowing, its 2.8 gate's predicate leg and its step-2.7 by-id read all ask `ql.find`/`findOne` under the caller's context. The seat ruled route (a), claim amendments 6895345175 and 6895620230: the write paths stay byte-identical to main. A write's middleware chain now runs inside an engine async scope, and step 5 drops nothing inside it. No plugin-security write-door source file changes.

## What changes

- `packages/objectql/src/engine-readable-ids-permission-formula.ts`: `composeReadableIdsChain` gains step 5. A leaf over the REQUIRED master of a `controlled_by_parent` object, in an AND position and as the whole comparand of a `$in` on its `master_detail` field, is dropped instead of composed. Two conditions must both hold:
  - the master's answered scope is `undefined` (admitted, no row condition), per hop: a nested scope left empty once its own leaves are dropped answers `undefined`, so a chain drops whole only when every hop is unrestricted;
  - the caller holds View All (`viewAllRecords` or `modifyAllRecords`) on the detail, read from `ISecurityService.getEffectiveObjectPermissions` (`readerViewsAllOf`, asked once per read). A delegated caller, a service without that member, or a call that throws keeps the chain. A failure costs the subquery, never a row.

  An optional master, a leaf inside `$or` or `$not`, and every non-`controlled_by_parent` object compose exactly as before.
- `packages/objectql/src/engine-middleware-and-context.ts`: **approved widening** (claim amendment 6895620230, `executeWithMiddleware` only, +4/−1). For a write-epoch operation (insert, update, delete, purge, restore), the middleware chain runs inside `READABLE_IDS_WRITE_IN_FLIGHT`, an `AsyncLocalStorage` exported from `engine-readable-ids-permission-formula.ts`. `readerViewsAllOf` answers false inside it, so every read made while a write runs keeps the chain: the security write-door reads, hook reads and cascade reads. It is an async scope rather than a context stamp, for the reason `SecurityPlugin.engineOperationScope` gives: a context is shared and spread across those very reads.
- `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts`: **approved widening** (coordinator, 2 lines). The private `composeReadableIdsChain` host literal gains a `_registry` getter, the same getter shape the neighbouring host literals use.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-plugin.ts`: a prose-only paragraph in the `computeControlledByParentFilter` docblock (review should-fix 2). It says the drop is read-only and that write paths keep the chain.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-plugin-cbp-read-filter.ts`: a docblock paragraph only. The leaf is still written for every caller, and the engine drops it. View All on the detail alone never drops it.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/controlled-by-parent-leaf-switch.test.ts`: **approved widening**. The existing pins are unchanged. A new reader (View All on the account, contact, quote and line objects) gets legs in the three leaf-switch tests, and those legs see the dangling and null rows and run one statement with no `in (select`.
- `.changeset/33696-drop-unrestricted-cbp-chain.md`: patch for `@objectstack/objectql`, with the ruling's release-note sentence.

Perf, the card's measurement, not re-run here (1M rows): page SQLite 397 to 281 ms, PG 97 to 56 ms; total SQLite 217 to 136 ms, PG 78 to 54 ms.

## Tests

Pins on a real stack (`security-plugin-cbp-read-filter.test.ts`: ObjectQL, SqlDriver on better-sqlite3, the real SecurityPlugin and SharingService, orphan rows seeded through the driver), 8 tests:

- (a) View All on the detail over unrestricted hops: no parent-chain subquery, every stored row including the orphans, count 7, `findOne` of a dangling row. Plus parity on the rows whose chain resolves, and the analytics door (the `getReadFilter` scope passed as `where`) composing the same way.
- (b) a reader with a restricted master hop keeps the whole chain and sees no orphan.
- (c) a reader with View All on the detail only keeps the whole chain and sees no orphan.
- (d) a plain member keeps the chain over a restricted master and over an unrestricted (`public_read_write`) one. The admin control on the same object drops it.
- (e) isolated tenancy: org A and org B never read each other's rows, and the tenant wall keeps the chain.
- An optional master keeps its leaf.

Write-door pins (review 6895328067, route (a)), in the same file, 4 tests. The View All admin reads over unrestricted hops, and the set it writes holds orphans:

- a hook's read inside a write, under the caller's context, keeps the chain and sees no orphan (control: the same caller's plain read drops it);
- a predicate delete over a set holding an empty-required-master orphan lands on the other row and leaves the orphan;
- a predicate update over a set holding an empty-master orphan and a dangling-master orphan lands on the other row and leaves both;
- a by-id update of a dangling orphan and a by-id delete of an empty-master orphan both still answer `RECORD_NOT_FOUND` / 404.

Measured on head 2c6025c0's objectql source (the three objectql files set back to 2c6025c0, then restored with `git diff HEAD` empty), all 4 are red:

| Pin | Red on 2c6025c0 |
|---|---|
| hook read | it sees the 4 orphans (`line_a_ghost`, `line_a_ghost_account`, `line_a_null`, `line_b_ghost`) |
| predicate delete | refused: `MISSING_REQUIRED_FIELD` / 422 |
| predicate update | refused: `MISSING_REQUIRED_FIELD` / 422 |
| by-id write | refused: `PERMISSION_DENIED` / 403, not `RECORD_NOT_FOUND` / 404 |

On origin/main's objectql source, the 3 write pins pass and the hook pin's write leg passes. Its plain-read control leg fails there, as it should, because main drops nothing. Ablations (`ablation-replace`, every restore checked as blob == HEAD):

- deleting the `READABLE_IDS_WRITE_IN_FLIGHT` guard in `readerViewsAllOf` turns all 4 red;
- running a write's chain outside the scope in `executeWithMiddleware` turns all 4 red.

Unit pins (`engine-readable-ids-nested-composition.test.ts`, a new describe, 17 tests in the file): the drop at the root, in an `$and` and in a merged-key position; a restricted hop keeps both leaves; `$or`, optional and non-cbp positions compose; five kinds of caller without View All on the detail keep the chain (no View All, View All on another object, no service member, a service that throws, delegated); a non-readable master gives `$in: []`.

Ablations, on the committed implementation (`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, every restore proven `blob == HEAD 8ec17d58c0bb` and `git diff HEAD` empty):

| Mutation | Real-stack pins red | Unit pins red |
|---|---|---|
| per-hop check removed (drop whenever the master answered) | (b), (c) | restricted hop keeps; caller without View All keeps |
| `readerViewsAllOf` answers `true` | (d) | caller without View All keeps |
| step 5 disabled | (a), parity, analytics, (d) admin control | drop at root and `$and`; `$or`/optional/non-cbp |

## Acceptance notes

- Loose-ends card owed (the ruling's one): stop orphan rows at their sources (option B of the original request). Measured sources: a system-context insert or update that names a missing master is stored (the documented residual in `engine-referential-integrity.ts`), and promoting an optional master to required leaves rows with a NULL foreign key. The seat files it.
- #33820 (skills lane) carries the ADR-0139 status-line amendment. This PR does not touch `docs/adr/**`.
- Under walled tenancy the tenant admin's master scope carries the Layer-0 tenant equality, so nothing is dropped there, by design. Pin (e) measures this.
- Open PR #33652 (another seat) edits the same function in `engine-readable-ids-permission-formula.ts`: the import line and the final `composeReadableIdsLeaves` call. The two PRs conflict as text, and whichever lands second rebases. They do not conflict in meaning. Its planned relation-semi-join leaves are never asked into `chain.answers`, and step 5 drops only a leaf whose master has an answer, so it leaves them alone. #33703 touches `engine.ts` far from this literal.

## Verification

- At head `df3fb3b9`, `dispatch-gates --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 77 gate families.
- 74 of them ran locally, every one exit 0. `--ran` reconciliation: "77 derived, 74 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 3 UNRUN". The 3 are whole-repo families left to CI: `check:i18n`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:type-check-debt`.
- `node scripts/check-nul-bytes.mjs` exit 0. `pnpm lint` (whole-repo eslint) is left to CI.
- `git merge-tree --write-tree --name-only` from `df3fb3b9`:
  - origin/main: clean. Main is now 18 commits ahead, and none of them touches this PR's files.
  - #33887 (`engine-middleware-and-context.ts`, its `claimReferentialCascadeDelete`): clean. This PR's hunk stays inside `executeWithMiddleware`.
  - #33884: merged into main as c59198f05 and included in this head.
  - #33652: conflicts in `engine-readable-ids-permission-formula.ts`, in two hunks: the import block and the step-5 / final `composeReadableIdsLeaves` lines. That overlap was known before. The two changes do not conflict in meaning, and whichever lands second rebases.
